title: Afternoon interview triage + followups
content:
Afternoon triage notes (quick, messy)

Top priorities (do now)
- [ ] Confirm next-step interviews for Asha Verma (Backend IC) — engineering panel on Thu 3/19 10:00 PST. Need interviewer RSVP: Lina, Marcus, DevInfra. If any decline, book backup (Joel).
- [ ] Follow up with Marcus O'Neill about interview feedback — sent takeaways 11:30am, no reply. Ping + ask availability for debrief call (15 min).
- [ ] Reschedule Priya Desai (PM) — candidate asked to move due to travel. Options I can offer: Fri 3/20 09:00 PST or Mon 3/23 13:00 PST. Note: Priya is +5:30 IST, prefer mornings PST to accommodate evening her time.

Quick scheduling checklist
- Timezone conversions: PST -> EST (+3), PST -> CET (+9), PST -> IST (+12.5) — double-check when proposing times.
- Use scheduling link only as last resort for panel interviews (we want panel coordination first).
- Add "travel conflict?" note in calendar invites for candidates who mentioned travel.

Candidate-specific micro-tasks
- Ethan Wu (SWE intern) — candidate sent coding challenge link, incomplete. Set reminder to follow up 3/18 if no submission. Template message: "Hi Ethan — quick check-in on the challenge; do you need any clarifications or extra time?"
- Asha Verma — verify laptop/table access for screen-share task (ask interviewer DevInfra to confirm).
- Marcus O'Neill — collect written feedback in GH PR template (link in JIRA REQ-9012) before debrief.

Messages to send (copy-paste-ready)
- To interviewer group for Asha:
  "Hey team — Asha Verma's panel is tentatively Thu 3/19 10:00 PST. Can you confirm availability? If you can't make it please suggest a 2-hour window for Fri 3/20. I'll lock invite after confirmations. Thanks — Zoe"

- To Priya (reschedule):
  "Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up. Are you available Fri 3/20 09:00 PST or Mon 3/23 13:00 PST? If neither works, tell me two windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Best, Zoe"

Notes to self / misc
- Prefer booking windows on recruiter calendar as provisional until all interviewers confirm.
- Follow-up cadence: 24 hours for interviewer RSVP, 48 hours for candidate updates.
- Add quick label in calendar title: "(Panel)" or "(Loop)" for easy inbox filtering.
- Check Confluence guide for panel setup checklist before sending invites (link in linked_artifacts).

Unresolved questions
- Do we still have overflow panel capacity on Fri 3/20 afternoon? (Ask Samir)
- Who is current backup for DevInfra interviews this week? (Hannah said Joel but confirm)

End-of-day wrap
- Send meeting summary to hiring manager for any closed loops.
- Update JIRA REQ-9012 with statuses: Asha = pending interviewer RSVP; Priya = candidate requested reschedule; Ethan = await code.

Random short-term reminders
- Swap interview room reservation for Tue 3/24 if onsite return confirmed.
- Move +30 buffer into all panel invites to prevent overlap.

---
Notes to self: keep this doc as ephemeral scratchpad. Move final confirmations into candidate records (Greenhouse/JIRA) and then delete or archive.
